$description: MyMzansi design tokens. W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all colour, type, spacing, radius, motion and icon values. Do not hardcode values anywhere; reference these tokens. Platform outputs (CSS, iOS, Android, Flutter, Tailwind) are generated from this file — never edited by hand.

org.mymzansi.meta.affiliation: Unofficial concept work. Not endorsed by the Presidency Digital Services Unit.

provenance.existing: color.palette.aloe-lt and color.palette.maize were read from the live mymzansi.gov.za stylesheet and are existing MyMzansi tokens.
provenance.proposed: indigo, ochre, bone and all corrected accents are proposed additions from the design direction work.
provenance.audited: All colour pairings audited against WCAG 2.1 on 2026-08-13. See BRAND.md section 4.6.

palette.$description: Primitive colours. NEVER reference these directly in a component. Reference semantic or theme tokens instead.

ink.$description: Near-black, slight green bias so it belongs to aloe rather than floating above it.

ink-3.$description: Meta/caption text. Corrected from #8A938F which failed AA at 2.75:1.

bone.$description: Warm paper ground. Lightened from #F2EFE8 so aloe-lt clears AA on it.

indigo.$description: Shweshwe indigo. Anchor, headers, dark surfaces.

indigo-lt.$description: Indigo for dark theme foreground use.

aloe.$description: Aloe green. Primary action and success. Use this, not aloe-lt, on tinted grounds.

aloe-lt.$description: EXISTING MyMzansi token. FRAGILE: 5.00:1 on pure white but only 4.36:1 on a warm off-white. Restricted to pure-white backgrounds. Prefer aloe.

aloe-br.$description: Aloe for dark theme foreground use.

maize.$description: EXISTING MyMzansi token. The joy colour. GROUND ONLY in light theme — see color.rules.

ochre.$description: Highveld earth. Warm accent. Corrected from #C1663A which failed AA as text at 3.50:1.

ochre-br.$description: Ochre for dark theme foreground use.

caution.$description: Caution AS TEXT. Corrected from #E0A21C which failed at 2.24:1. For caution as a FILL use maize with ink on top.

chalk-3.$description: Dark theme meta text. Corrected from #767E88 which failed at 4.40:1.

rule.$description: Light theme border. Decorative only — 1.33:1, does not meet 3:1.

theme.$description: Theme-resolved surface and text tokens. Components MUST reference these, never palette directly.

anchor-fill.$description: Filled header/anchor surface. Distinct from `anchor`, which is a FOREGROUND colour and inverts in dark mode — filling with it flips the design.

on-anchor.$description: The only text colour permitted on anchor-fill.

anchor-fill.$description: Stays deep indigo in dark mode — a header must not invert into a light band.

on-anchor.$description: The only text colour permitted on anchor-fill.

semantic.$description: Meaning-carrying colours. MUST NOT be the same token as brand accent — when accent and success are one token, neither reading is reliable.

caution-fill.$description: Fill only. Pair with color.palette.ink on top (11.10:1).

restricted.$description: Not-yet-available, as distinct from failed. A warm limit, not a grey one.

sans.$description: Interim choice — it is the existing MyMzansi face. MUST be re-evaluated against the language coverage requirement in BRAND.md section 5.4 before being fixed.

mono.$description: Reference numbers, IDs, codes. Anything a person may need to read aloud or transcribe.

typography.$description: Composite type styles. Sizes in px at base density. MUST scale with OS text-size settings — never lock to px in a way that ignores user preference.

space.$description: Extends the existing MyMzansi scale (xs 0.5rem, sm 1rem, md 1.5rem, lg 2.5rem, xl 3.75rem) with the intermediate steps it was missing.

min-spaced.$description: Use where targets sit adjacent, or where the action is destructive or irreversible.

status.$description: Width of the left status rail that replaces icon circles in lists.

icon.$description: MyMzansi already loads Material Symbols Outlined (observed in the live stylesheet). Standardise on it: Apache-2.0, open, no new dependency, aligns with the digital-public-goods posture.

org.mymzansi.iconset.rule: Use one style throughout. Do not mix outlined and filled to signal state — use the status rail and a text label instead.

failed.$description: System could not complete. NEVER phrase as user error.

restricted.$description: Not yet available at this assurance level.

instant.$description: Maximum acceptable latency before a tap shows feedback.

deliberate.$description: RESERVED for the verification moment only. No other use.

overshoot.$description: Confirmation only. One overshoot, never a bounce loop.

maxTotal.$description: HARD CAP regardless of item count. Compute interval as min(45ms, 300ms / itemCount).

elevation.$description: Use sparingly. Shadows are paint-heavy on low-end GPUs. Prefer a surface change or a border over a shadow.

budget.$description: Non-visual constraints that are as binding as any colour rule.

org.mymzansi.budget.note: Zero-rating covers the platform origin only. Any third-party origin — font CDN, analytics, image host — costs the user money and breaks the zero-rating guarantee.
